==English==
[[File:Fortune cookie broken 20040628 223252 1.jpg|thumb|A fortune cookie that has been broken open.]]
[[File:Fortune Cookies (3225487289).jpg|thumb|An unopened fortune cookie.]]

===Etymology===
First attested in 1942 (see quotations below). 

The slang sense is from the canine vulva resembling the cleft shape of the snack. 

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-fortune cookie.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A type of hollow [[snack]], common in [[westernized]] [[Chinese]] [[cuisine]]: a [[crisp]] [[sugary]] [[wafer]] containing a message on a narrow strip of [[paper]], generally with a wise or vaguely prophetic message or random numbers usable in a lottery printed on the paper.
#* {{quote-book|en|date=1942-05-08|title=The Carmel Pine Cone|url=https://archive.org/details/ccarm_002432/page/n7/mode/2up?q=%22fortune+cookies%22|text={{...}}the Chinese atmosphere of the afternoon was pleasantly deepened with real Chinese tea, '''fortune cookies''' and honest to goodness ginger which Mrs. Palmtag managed to find some place (in Monterey){{...}}}}
#* {{quote-song|en|title=Courtesy Laughs|artist={{w|Phoenix (band)|Phoenix}}|year=2006|album=It's Never Been Like That|passage=I read my future in a '''fortune cookie''' / Without any safety procedure in mind}}
# {{lb|en|computing}} A quote-of-the-day feature (especially on [[*nix]] systems.)
# {{lb|en|furry|slang}} The [[vulva]] of canine species.
#* {{RQ:Bluesky|en|date=2025-07-27|handle=talkshowghost.com|id=3luxresfkic2r|archiveurl=https://megalodon.jp/2026-0317-2050-01/https://bsky.app:443/profile/talkshowghost.com/post/3luxresfkic2r|archivedate=2026-03-17|passage=that's why I love wearing a skirt with no underwear! plus if you see someone cute you can flash them your plump juicy '''fortune cookie''' and tease them when they get an obvious bulge with a wet spot :3}}
